name: cascader-columns
title: Columns mode
description: Columns mode. Core/Advanced Inputs/Cascader pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Cascader and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.

    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
function collection(libraryValue, name, rows) {
  const value = `${libraryValue}.${slug(name)}`;
  return {
    value,
    label: name,
    icon: collectionIcon,
    children: rows.map(([title, kind, length]) => ({
      value: `${value}.${slug(title)}`,
      label: title,
      icon: kindIcons[kind],
      data: { kind, length }
    }))
  };
}
